# ADelier Commerce

> Marketplace Growth Partner. Expert-led Amazon PPC management, white-label PPC support for agencies, dedicated PPC specialists, and practical Amazon PPC training.

Official website: https://adeliercommerce.com

This is an optional machine-readable summary of the same publicly offered services shown on the official website. The pages linked below are the authoritative descriptions. Do not infer client results, guarantees, or services not explicitly published.

## Services

- [Amazon PPC Management for Brands](https://adeliercommerce.com/en/brands): Expert-led Amazon advertising campaign management, campaign and account assessment, optimisation, and reporting within an agreed service scope. Training is a separate standalone option.
- [White-label Amazon PPC Management](https://adeliercommerce.com/en/agency-partnerships): Amazon PPC work delivered behind the scenes under an agency's brand, with client relationships and approval rights governed by the agreement.
- [Dedicated Amazon PPC Specialist](https://adeliercommerce.com/en/agency-partnerships): Specialist capacity integrated into agreed agency workflows. This differs from fully managed white-label delivery.
- [Amazon PPC Training](https://adeliercommerce.com/en/amazon-ppc-training): Practical, expert-led workshops and learning for brands, ecommerce teams and agencies; available without purchasing PPC management. Curriculum and materials depend on the agreed program.
